posts.title: Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs
posts.author: speckx
posts.description: Following the departure of now-former NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, a new report by The Wall Street Journal (via Wccftech) has emerged alleging that NVIDIA artificially inflated the ongoing GPU and memory shortage by investing in AI startups that would go on to buy NVIDIA GPUs and build data centers....

posts.title: Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
posts.author: firloop
posts.description: Our forensic analysis of publicly released AI models finds evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group have gained access to NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPUs, despite restrictions on exporting these chips to China, and are using that hardware to create their AI models.
